messages:
jamal: quick question — we're seeing a weird precedence issue during a canary. route has a model override but some canary traffic still served the org model. expected route override to win. anyone seen this?

olivia: route-level overrides should win. can you paste the flag config + how the canary is defined? :eyes:

jamal: pasted below (sanitized):
```json
{
  "flag": "use-new-embedder",
  "scopes": ["org:acme", "project:payments", "route:/v2/embeds", "model:embed-2b"],
  "overrides": {
    "route:/v2/embeds": {"model": "embed-3b-quant", "canary": "5%"},
    "project:payments": {"model": "embed-3b", "canary": "10%"}
  }
}
```

maria: hmm the canary gating for project-level is implemented as a routing policy that runs before scope resolution in the old flow. that means project canary assignment can override later route mapping if the runtime picks path early. we changed that in the refactor but maybe the rollout didn't pick it up.

derrick: we shipped a change last week to evaluate scope precedence earlier, but only for "override_priority: route,project,org" configs. if the flag has inherit=true or no explicit override_priority the system falls back to older ordering (project before route).

jamal: ah — flag had no override_priority set. so runtime used legacy ordering. repro: hit /v2/embeds with 5% header, still routed to org model. logs show matcher matched project canary first.

olivia: thanks — two paths to fix: 1) set explicit override_priority on the flag to prefer route first (recommended), or 2) flip the global rollout gate in staging to the new precedence (we're still running gradual rollout).

jamal: for transparency, here's the minimal delta to set on the flag:
```yaml
override_priority: [route, model, project, org]
inherit: false
```

maria: +1. also add a guardrail: when a route-scoped model override exists, block project-level canary if models are incompatible (different tokenizer/quantization). we had a bug where incompatible models got mixed on the same request path.

derrick: good call. I'll add a validation in the UI/API that prevents overlapping canaries for conflicting model families unless the flag author explicitly acknowledges the risk.

jamal: filing a quick follow-up: can someone confirm which workspace envs still have the legacy precedence? tagging @eng-platform for visibility.

olivia: staging and eu-prod are still on legacy; canary-prod flipped yesterday. I'll update the rollout board.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: precedence-fix toggles -> staging (ci-9876). ETA 15m. :rocket:

jamal: thanks. once staging is green I'll update the payments flag with explicit override_priority. pinging for code review: @olivia @derrick — quick lgtm?

olivia: will review in a bit, looks small.

maria: leaving a note in the flag docs about the explicit priority recommendation and adding a short example snippet for route-first canaries.

jamal: perfect. closing the loop — will post follow-up in this thread after staging deploy. :thumbsup:
